notes.title: Dawnsbury Days, the sequel, is now released!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2693730/Dawnsbury_Days/

Dawnsbury Days, the sequel to Quest for the Golden Candelabra, has just been released. It includes all the content in this game and more:

[list]
[*] A more advanced implementation of the PF2E tabletop system, with more rules fidelity and more options
[*] A character builder
[*] 12 classes, from the Fighter to the Wizard to the Kineticist, each with different play patterns
[*] 110+ feats and 70+ spells to further customize your characters
[*] 20+ encounters in the main story-driven adventure path, and 10+ additional scenarios in free encounter mode
[*] Character level cap is 4.
[*] The continuation of the story of the Dawnsbury Four
[*] Support for custom maps, encounters and portraits
[*] Support for custom mods to add new ancestries, feats, rules and more
[/list]

Let me show you some screenshots!

First, the main battle screen has a minor visual overhaul, notably for the map itself:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022309/2492da68ff70de6f5847c6c74aa08468fddb7cbc.png[/img]

Next, it contains an advanced character builder that lets you build a variety of characters (I'll repeat: 12 classes, 110+ feats, 70+ spells):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022309/a4e7a8195ab4635334bb4fb7558658df3d64a9f3.png[/img]

There is also a very large number of items — weapons, armor, consumables and other useful things you can take with you on the adventure:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022309/464583a5c0f7945ec9beacd4f7b99b7b36947cc5.png[/img]

Of course, the main mode in the Story mode which contains an extended campaign that takes you from level 1 to level 4:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022309/b66b63e95c13e044298335a441572bdfde889446.png[/img]

And finally, the new game supports modding. Already 17 mods are available from the Steam Workshop, including, for example, DawnniExpanded, which adds an additional class, 35+ additional feats, 7 additional spells, dozens of new items and more:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022309/677a0f178ef6a77567a740ddba01de660f3b714a.png[/img]

If you find any of this of interest, please consider checking out Dawnsbury Days!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2693730/Dawnsbury_Days/

notes.title: You can now wishlist Dawnsbury Days on Steam!
notes.content:
Dawnsbury Days, the sequel to Quest for the Golden Candelabra, now has its own Steam page at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2693730/Dawnsbury_Days/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2693730/Dawnsbury_Days/[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022309/2492da68ff70de6f5847c6c74aa08468fddb7cbc.png[/img]

The sequel builds on top of this game, and adds among other things:
[list]
[*] A level 1-4 adventure path with 16 additional encounters; plus an extra 10+ extra encounters
[*] Character customization with 4 ancestries, 9 classes, over 100 feats and over 60 spells
[*] A character level cap of 4.
[*] Modding support for custom encounters, feats, spells, classes and more
[*] A more complete PF2E ruleset implementation
[/list]
If you liked Quest for the Golden Candelabra and want to experience the continuation of the story of the Dawnsbury Four or just more tactical gameplay, please go ahead and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2693730/Dawnsbury_Days/]wishlist Dawnsbury Days[/url]!

notes.title: Announcing Dawnsbury Days
notes.content:
I'm opening a Patreon campaign at [url=https://www.patreon.com/dawnsbury]https://www.patreon.com/dawnsbury[/url] to help fund the development of [b]Dawnsbury Days[/b], an expansion or a sequel to Quest for the Golden Candelabra.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022309/a4e7a8195ab4635334bb4fb7558658df3d64a9f3.png[/img]

I plan for Dawnsbury Days to contain all the content in Quest for the Golden Candelabra, plus an additional 15 encounters, a downtime mode, a character builder allowing you to create characters up to level 4, inventory management, more OGL content, a more complete PF2E implementation as well as the ability to play custom encounters.

By becoming a Patreon patron, you gain access to the development build of the game, the ability to vote for content, and possibly to also suggest content for inclusion in the game. I plan to use funds from the Patreon to commission art, and to purchase assets I will need for the greater scope of Dawnsbury Days.

If:
[list]
[*] you're interested in seeing this new turn-based tactics game with cRPG elements come to life;
[*] you're interested in living through more adventures with the Dawnsbury Four;
[*] you want to create your characters to fight in difficult encounters within the PF2E rules system
[/list] 
then please consider joining the Dawnsbury Days [url=https://www.patreon.com/dawnsbury]Patreon[/url]!

Here's the full plan for Dawnsbury Days content:
[list]
[*] [b]A campaign of 20 encounters.[/b] The story of the Dawnsbury Four will continue after they retrieve the Golden Candelabra in another 15 encounters, with each encounter having an opening and closing cutscene. All cutscenes will still be voice acted.
[*] [b]Better downtime mode.[/b] There will be no exploration mode, but at some points in the main adventure path, you get access to downtime and shops.
[*] [b]Character advancement.[/b] You will advance characters from level 1 up to level 4 (one level up after every 5 encounters).
[*] [b]Inventory management.[/b] There will be a true inventory, which also includes the armor slot. You will also earn gold to purchase magic items with during downtime.
[*] [b]OGL content:[/b] 20 encounters; 20 monsters and hazards; 50 spells; 3 ancestries (human, elf, orc); 4 classes (fighter, rogue, sorcerer, cleric)
[*] [b]Feats:[/b] 6-9 feats per class; 4-6 feats per ancestry; 15 general feats; no skill feats
[*] [b]More complete PF2E implementation.[/b] There will be a Hide/Seek subsystem (although lighting will still be excluded), Tumble through, full proficiency rules, among other rules fidelity improvements.
[/list]
Of course, ✂️ cutting features is an inevitable part of a game that wants to be released at some point, so I cannot guarantee that all of the above content will be present in the final game.

Also, I'm only working on this game in my free time, in evenings and on weekends, so there is always a risk that I'll lack time or stop working on the game altogether, so please be aware.

But I'll do my best.

notes.title: Version 1.18 (May 13th)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Feature: Added inventory management also to the main bottom bar where it can more easily be seen.
[*] Balancing: Annacoesta is now trained in Intimidation.
[*] Rules fidelity: Dropping an item on the ground now doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity.
[*] Rules fidelity: Added an optional rule toggle that enables items to be dropped on the ground when a hero falls unconscious.
[*] Bugfix: Fixed that you could use Feint against mindless creatures.
[*] Bugfix: Fixed that Standing up from Prone didn't provoke attacks of opportunity.
[*] Bugfix: Fixed that Feint was affected by the multiple attack penalty
[*] Bugfix: Fixed that you could stow and drop grappled creatures, and that this caused a progression-breaking crash.
[*] User interface: Fixed that on the end credits scene, the list of play testers was covered by buttons. 
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.14 (April 30th) [release candidate]
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Feature: Replaced the playtest feedback form with the final feedback form (playtesters please continue to use the old greater playtest form that you receive with your invitation to playtest).
[*] User interface: Replaced yellow squares of Bless and Warm glow with a magic circle texture centered on the source.
[*] User interface: Added link to Discord server, and restructured the main menu.
[*] User interface: Replaced small-caps font for section names, and made it work also for smaller UI.
[*] User interface: Archon's Retributive strike ability now appears as an overhead and in logs.
[*] Audio: Adjusted volume of some sound effects.
[*] Audio: Reduced the volume of sound effects and voice with regards to the music.
[*] Audio: Fixed that Saffi was using female combat sounds.
[*] Bugfix: Fixed a bug that a character with both hands free could not pick up items.
[*] Bugfix: Fixed a bug that even if a creature you grappled die, you would maintain the grapple.
[*] Rules fidelity: Fixed that you couldn't Delay while slowed.
[/list]
This version is a release candidate: If nothing else critical pops up from playtest, this is a version I'd be happy to set live when the game releases.

notes.title: Version 1.10 (April 25th)
notes.content:
- Feature: By default, you must now double-click to Stride. You can switch back to single-click in Settings.
- Feature: By default, you are now asked if you want to take a reaction. You can switch back to auto reactions in Settings.
- Feature: Added the combat action "Delay".
- Feature: Added the option to drop items as a free action, and to pick them back up.
- Bugfix: Fixed that Tok'dar didn't have an attack of opportunity in the previous version.
